explication: OpenTUI is a TypeScript terminal-UI framework backed by a Zig/native core, with React and Solid adapters and companion packages for key routing, QR codes, 3D graphics, and SSH-hosted sessions. The main workflow is to compose UI elements, handle terminal input, and render the result to a terminal; framework adapters mount into the core renderer. Package capabilities are taken from the README and tree, while some internal wiring is not shown in the sampled source, so those links are omitted.
